name: Loli Bitch ~Houkago no Yagai Play~
original_name: ロリビッチ～放課後の野外プレイ～
source:
Two lolitas are just beginning to have an interest in sex.
As the player you can choose how they hook up
by clicking the icons on the town map.

One time may be a student in the park, another time
a business man at the train station.
There are a variety of places and partners. 

[From [url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE115561.html]DLsite English[/url]]
